g.text: The finite fit is still N log N
Native CPU nanoseconds / N · N = n + m
Four realizations per solver; no pooling.
Lines: six-call medians; faint stems: full
ranges. Log axes. Google selected N log N
on all 24 library-CPU curves. A finite fit
does not prove an asymptotic bound.
